summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 8,247,420 Class A ordinary shares and warrants at $0.97 per unit for $8 million gross proceeds. This is a routine capital raising via an effective shelf registration, not a special situation. Terms include Series A (5-year, $0.97 exercise) and Series B (2-year, $0.97) warrants with reset and cashless exercise features. D. Boral Capital acted as placement agent for 7% fee. No board recommendation or strategic change noted. Routine equity issuance; no event-driven catalyst.
